data.description: Spacious | Corner Unit | Maids Room | Vacant
data.long_description:
Presenting a rare corner unit in the sought-after Zinnia community, R2EM cluster, offering enhanced privacy, additional natural light, and a well-planned family-friendly layout. This vacant 3-bedroom townhouse is ideal for end-users or investors looking for a ready-to-move-in home in a peaceful residential setting.

The property features a closed kitchen, providing separation from the living and dining areas, ideal for practical family living. Each bedroom is generously sized, complemented by five bathrooms, including a maid’s room with ensuite, ensuring comfort and convenience for all occupants.

Property Details & Features:

3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
5 Bathrooms
Corner Unit – more privacy and light
Closed Kitchen
Located in R2EM Cluster, Zinnia
Vacant and Ready to Move In
Well-proportioned living and dining areas
Family-oriented community environment

Zinnia is known for its calm surroundings, landscaped spaces, and easy access to key roads and community amenities, making it an excellent choice for modern family living.
